title: Sensorium: An Open-Source Multimodal Data Collection and Curation Library for Embodied Surgical AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.41946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embodied surgical AI requires reliable multimodal data, yet surgical data collection remains costly, difficult to repeat, and strongly dependent on the hardware setup. We present Sensorium, an open-source Python library for recording, processing, annotating, and curating multimodal surgical data from configurable robot and sensor streams using the Robot Operating System (ROS) and ROS2 middleware. The library combines operator-facing data acquisition, configurable processing, semantic annotation, and episodic dataset generation. We evaluate Sensorium across 1516 recordings of phantom, ex vivo, and in vivo porcine experiments involving multiple surgical tasks and sensing configurations, and report preliminary usability feedback.

translated_title: Sensorium：一个面向具身手术人工智能的开源多模态数据收集与整理库
translated_abstract: 具身手术人工智能需要可靠的多模态数据，然而手术数据的收集成本高昂、难以重复，且严重依赖于硬件配置。我们提出了Sensorium，这是一个开源的Python库，基于机器人操作系统（ROS）和ROS2中间件，用于从可配置的机器人和传感器数据流中记录、处理、标注和整理多模态手术数据。该库集成了面向操作者的数据采集、可配置的处理流程、语义标注以及情景化数据集生成功能。我们在1516次记录上对Sensorium进行了评估，这些记录来自体模、离体和体内猪实验，涉及多种手术任务和传感配置，并报告了初步的可用性反馈。
tldr: Sensorium是一个基于ROS/ROS2的开源Python库，用于记录、处理、标注和整理多模态手术数据，并已在1516次体模、离体和体内猪实验记录中得到验证，为具身手术AI提供了低成本、可复现的数据收集与整理解决方案。
